item: Page check past 4 GiB on the app's own side (R134 option A): SQLCipher-4 page tags verified in src/database/page_auth.py for main files longer than 2^32 bytes; the pragma path below is unchanged
summary: PRAGMA cipher_integrity_check wraps at 2^32 bytes (4,925 false rows on a healthy 4.37 GB store), so the verifier withheld every verdict past 4 GiB. page_auth.py derives the tag key once (bytearray, wiped in a finally on every path, passphrase reference dropped at once), reads 4 MiB chunks and judges each page's HMAC-SHA512 tag; calibration on pages 1-9 makes a mismatch unchecked with a reason, never damaged; the lock-byte page (2^30) is skipped as the engine does; unread pages are counted, never failing; R100's second read still confirms. Real run on a 4.37 GB store: ok in 8.4-8.7 s warm, 53 MB RSS; 8 injected inverted bytes -> 7 named. 38 mutants killed; sink tests plant the passphrase and derived key bytes. Carries two positional-only-default plants in test_runs_log_sinks.
